premises.statement: Commas inside the packed raw records occur only as field delimiters, not inside quoted or escaped field values.
premises.reason: An embedded comma would shift subsequent field values into the wrong columns, potentially corrupting many staging inputs.

premises.statement: Every packed record contains fields in precisely the order and positions specified by its comma-separated column header.
premises.evidence_of_dependence: cols=[x.strip() for x in header.split(',') if x.strip()]; ... list_extract({split},{i}) AS {x}
premises.reason: Positional extraction silently misassigns or loses values when record layouts differ from the header.

premises.statement: Leading and trailing whitespace is insignificant for every field extracted from the packed raw records.
premises.reason: Unconditional trimming changes source values before any column-specific contract transformations are applied.
